item.title: Texas Quantum Partners And Samara to Build Occam Foundry, A Quantum Technology Campus in Austin
item.summary: Insider Brief PRESS RELEASE — Texas Quantum Partners and Samara, a Texas real estate developer, today announced Occam Foundry, a quantum technology campus taking shape in Austin.
